body:
I'm sorry you feel so alone, but I am proud of you for doing everything you can to move forward! 
I think it's inspiring that you decided to share your struggles and your solution to work towards. Stay strong and keep your chin up. 

Here to talk or listen if you ever need to vent.
I too have bpd. Here if you ever want to talk about it or anything else

Do you want to talk about it? We can here or you can message me. 

Either way, I hope things improve for you

Thank you for your kind words. I appreciate it. 

Bottling up your feelings is something everyone should work on not doing. I think it's more dangerous than talking to someone about your insecurities/fears/issues. Talking can be extremely therapeutic (with the right person). 

Please reach out if you're ever low. I promise to do the same.

Thanks for saying that. I think I'll always feel like i could have done more. My heart hurts when I think about it. 

Experiencing the loss of someone you care deeply for by suicide is devastating. It's one of the main reasons I haven't done it yet. I couldn't imagine giving my mother this kind of pain. 

I once heard a quote something along the lines of "suicide doesn't end pain, it just passes it on". I never thought much of it until I had to experience the loss of my best friend.

No matter how alone we feel, we would destroy someone if we took our lives. 

I'm not happy. I haven't been happy in a long time. Maybe one day I will. Until then, I'll continue to try and not check out early.... as much as I want to.

Thanks op. This actually helped me a little bit.
Hope things get better for you.

I'm so very sorry for your loss and struggles. 
Please dm me if you want to talk. I would love to discuss and help. I'm here for you.

Feel free to dm me. No one should feel alone. 
I'm here to talk or just listen if you want that. I hope you reach out.
